_howToEdit: Add one object per product to "items". Put photos in public/images/merch/ and write them as "images/merch/your-photo.jpg". price is in Brunei dollars (number). status: "available", "preorder" or "soldout". orderUrl is the link buyers use to order (Google Form, WhatsApp link, Instagram DM, etc.); leave it empty to use MERCH_ORDER_URL from src/config.js, or the ESC email if that is empty too. Copy _example into items to start.

_example.name: ESC T-shirt (Maroon)
_example.description: Soft cotton tee with the ESC crest.
